lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice ska plus infinitive for near-future plans.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Colleagues talk briefly about evening and weekend plans.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Asking and answering what someone is going to do.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik talk about what they are going to do tonight or this weekend, keeping the plans simple and familiar.

main_focus.name: ska plus infinitive for plans
main_focus.description: Use ska before an infinitive to talk about planned near-future actions.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use ska plus infinitive naturally 4-6 times in the dialogue.

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use plan vocabulary that supports short, believable answers.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker asks about plans for tonight or the weekend.
dialogue_shape.middle: They exchange two or three planned activities and react briefly.
dialogue_shape.ending: They wish each other a good evening or weekend.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat ska in natural plan questions and answers

focus: what one speaker is going to do tonight
what plan is mentioned for the weekend
how the speakers close the plan conversation

sentence_focus: one question with vad ska du göra
one sentence about meeting a friend
one sentence about cooking at home
one sentence beginning with i helgen
one friendly closing about the evening
